description:
Create a dimensioned 2D floor plan of an office room using the Draft workbench. 

1. Create a new document.
2. Switch to the Draft workbench.
3. Draw a Rectangle representing the room with Width=5000 mm and Height=4000 mm. Place it starting at (0,0).
4. Draw a Hexagon (Polygon) representing a meeting table. Center it at (2500, 2000), with a Radius of 600 mm.
5. Add a Dimension to the bottom wall (measuring the 5000 mm width).
6. Save the FreeCAD file to '/home/ga/Documents/FreeCAD/office_layout.FCStd'.
7. Export the drawing to a DXF file named '/home/ga/Documents/FreeCAD/office_layout.dxf'.
